data.name: Project Hoyrá
data.detailed_description:
Project Hoyrá

Project Hoyrá is a narrative Action-Adventure game taking place in a new mature fantasy post-apocalyptic universe in third-person view, with a realistic art direction.

Main Storyline

In the fantasy world of Hoyrá, the vast majority of the O’Navlás, element manipulators that used to populate magnificent ancient civilizations, has been decimated by a mysterious cataclysm. 

The Natarës, a new civilization of powerless humans that emerged following the catastrophe, are extremely hostile towards the last O’Navlás and track them down relentlessly. 

Alerted by a new rumour, Elduin, one of the last surviving Water O’Navlás, is unexpectedly set to travel the world and investigate the past on a dangerous journey across Hoyrá.
Through survival and exploration, he will try to find his people and will meet Aelyn, a reckless and tormented Thunder O’Navlá who’s on a secret mission to earn her freedom.
